reason: Room: the candidate grows main RAM code by 44 bytes, which the shipping build absorbs (193 free before unused_3400_original), but the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW build (the proof gate's oracle; SKY_HELI off there, so the kind cache's builder sits in the same free block) has only 4 bytes free (&33FC-&3400). Applied to a clean HEAD copy in scratch: 'make DEFINES=DEBUG_FULLREDRAW' fails with 'src/game.6502: error: layer 1's code overruns the free block by 40 bytes' (and the save-arena carrier overruns by 2); the same build at HEAD assembles. The shipping, SKY_HELI=0 and gameplay builds assemble. Logic itself looks equivalent (C=0 reasoning, +4 entry kept, EOR #&0D vs CMP), but the oracle build breaking makes the change unprovable and violates the every-flag-set-assembles rule.
